name: MiniMax-M3
description: MiniMax's open-weights Mixture-of-Experts multimodal model, using MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) to enable low-latency long-context reasoning up to 1 million tokens.
keyFeatures: Total 428B parameters with 23B active parameters per token
MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) replacing full attention with KV-block selection
Native multimodal support spanning text, image, and video inputs
curatorNotes: Shanghai-based MiniMax's flagship MoE model, highly regarded for agentic code planning and 1M context window scaling.
